title: NIFT
tagline: Gift vouchers as NFT; To appreciate anyone just gift them an NFT voucher
description:
NIFT= NFT GIFT = Gift vouchers

Now you can send gift vouchers containing tokens to any address. We allow you to send a message along with the gift tokens all bundled in an NFT. Its a simple ERC721 Contract with options for Minting NFT and redeeming NIFTVoucher.

Used Scroll alpha testnet to deploy
how_its_made:
Just an ERC721 NFT Contract deployed on scroll , which can be used to gift tokens to others.
deployment link: https://blockscout.scroll.io/address/0xC7970e9C5AA18a7A9Bf21C322BFa8eceBE7B7A26
